title: Syracuse should end top lawyer’s side job to avoid conflicts (Editorial Board Opinion)
summary: Editorial board opinion piece criticizes City Hall's arrangement allowing the corporation counsel to maintain a one-day-per-week outside law firm position, citing unmanaged conflicts of interest and lack of transparency. The piece calls for ending this arrangement to protect city interests and governance integrity.

political_signal.description: Editorial board applying public pressure on city administration regarding potential conflicts of interest in top legal officer's dual employment arrangement; advocacy for policy change to remove outside work arrangement.
